label: The Hermes mirror is a commit gate: the pre-commit hook runs sync-skills-hermes.cjs --check inside MIRROR_CHECKS, blocks with BLOCKED [gate:mirror-parity], prints the failure tail and names the fix (Fix: node <script>, then git add its output; bypass SPECKIT_SKIP_MIRROR_PARITY=1)

Orphan .hermes/skills/sk-code-obsidian and sk-code-webflow copies are flagged STALE (exit 1) by --check and pruned (pruned 2) by the next write run; recheck PASS 66 copies in sync. Resolves iteration-1 open sub-question and the 025 F69 contradiction: the copies exist in the tree but the mirror self-heals

Runtime mirrors carry neither example and encode no surface order: sync-runtime-mirrors --check PASS 181 mirrors across 8 trees (exit 0); check-agent-mirror-sync --all 11 agents in sync (exit 0), both after the delete in the copy

A bare delete (rm -rf of both example dirs, no registry/router update) hard-fails the doctor check: 113 invariant failures, exit 1 — 3c x2 (names the README closure), 5d (missing router resources), 10a MODE_LEAF_SET_COLLISION between the removed modes, ~100 12a-router-contract RRC-006 lines; the scaffolded removal command /create:skill-parent update --surfaces is named nowhere in this wall

The drift umbrella fails after the same bare delete: 2 guard(s) FAILED, exit 1; doc-claims (verify-doc-claims.cjs) lists unresolved links into the deleted examples from sk-code-quality/SKILL.md:113,129-132,323-326, sk-code-quality/README.md:61,133, sk-code-quality/assets/code-quality-checklist/verification-quick-reference-and-related.md:126,130 and hub SKILL.md:203 — the packets that stay are not delete-clean; contradicts 026 R2 as a bare-delete tolerance claim

The sk-code hub manual-testing playbook names the examples as live surfaces in 21 files (159 hits): surface-detection/webflow-detection.md, obsidian-detection.md, opencode-detection.md, 7 cross-stack-routing files, compiled-routing/surface-bundle-compiled-routing.md; no gate runs them; not in 025 R3 removal checklist
The sk-code feature catalog still presents the examples as live surface packets (feature-catalog.md:15,35; two-axis-registry-driven-routing.md:26); no gate compares the catalog to mode-registry.json
Benchmarks cannot fail on the delete: retired frozen lane (README.md:13-16), only frozen report JSON and that README carry exact names, and benchmark/ is in the Hermes sync EXCLUDED_DIRECTORIES
The advisor runtime has zero example-name references (grep over .skilled/skills/system-skill-advisor → 0 files, batteries and tests included); extends 025 F12/F70

Doctor 5l blind spot: an undeclared stand-in placed after sk-code-opencode gets PASS from 5l and only 5e's generic permutation extra (exit 1); declared as packetKind surface, 5l FAILs with the named fix (move ahead, or re-add via /create:skill-parent update --surfaces). 5l is a softFail that is FAIL by default under STRICT_HUB_CANON, WARN only with PARENT_HUB_CHECK_STRICT=0
5l example exemption works post-delete: PASS tieBreak places no added surface after the native surface; 5e/5b/5a/5c/5f/5g/5h/5i also pass; delete-induced failures live in 3c/5d/10a/12a and doc-claims

Option: name the scaffolded removal command in the 3c failure message (parent-skill-check.cjs); prevents the 113-failure bare-delete wall whose only pointer is the README closure; cost is one message string, doctor output only; cheaper move (README-only documentation) fails because the failure message is what a blocked user sees first

Option: make 5l also flag undeclared tieBreak names after the native surface (checkNativeSurfaceLast filter, parent-skill-check.cjs:1170-1171); prevents a hand-added name after sk-code-opencode getting only 5e's generic permutation extra with no tie-order hint; cost is one filter branch and double-reporting care; cheaper move (rely on 5e) fails because 5e never explains the tie cost or names the update command
